verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents an emergency-stop or safety-interlock pattern in ROS 2. Lifecycle nodes, QoS reliability policies, action cancellation and real-time support are generic building blocks a developer might use to build such patterns, not documented safety patterns, so they earn no credit. The community report of UR3e arms e-stopping describes a hardware stop after a control-loop failure, not a ROS 2 capability.

support.subject: As a robotics engineer, I can implement emergency-stop and safety-interlock patterns the platform documents and supports
